checks.check: [A] a_T^dag a_S prod a_s a_s^dag = |T><S| (n = 2,3,4, all p, S, T)
[B] Phi^p(rho) = p! sum_T A_T rho A_T^dag (random mixed rho, n = 2..5)
[C] Spec Phi^p(rho) = p! Spec rho_p, full 2^n spectra (106 pure-state cases)
[C'] p = 1: Spec Phi(rho) = Spec rho_1 (conjecture holds as stated)
[C''] p >= 2: Spec Phi^p(rho) != Spec rho_p (conjecture fails as stated)
[D] eigenvector map c -> sum_T conj(c_T) A_T psi
[E] nonzero spectrum of tuple-indexed p-RDM = nonzero spectrum of Phi^p(rho)
[F] fixed N (pure and mixed): Phi^(N-p)(rho) = (N-p)! rho_p
[F'] Proposition 4 of the source without the factorial fails when N-p >= 2
[G3] two-mode example of the source: both spectra = {1-|c00|^2, |c11|^2, 0, 0}

limits: Floating-point checks of the identities of the manuscript on random pure and mixed states with n <= 6 modes; not a formal proof or a certification of novelty.
